macros.name: MakeluastringCommands
macros.doc: \MakeluastringCommands [def]{spec} will let \plluastring (A|B|C..) be \luastring (N|O|T|F) based on the letters that spec is set to (or def(ault) if nothing is provided) This is useful if you want to write a command with flexibility on argument expansion.

macros.name: writePDFmetadata
macros.doc: \writePDFmetadata runs the lua function penlight.tex.writePDFmetadata(), which pushes the lua variable __PDFmetadata__ (a table) to the xmpdata file.
